title: His, her, their: the shared third-person ending
focus: His, her, and their use the same third-person possessive ending. With the back-vowel nouns pallo, kirja, and auto, that ending is -nsa.

exercises.prompt: Choose the noun in “his ball”: hänen ___. Use pallo (“ball”).
exercises.explanation: pallo + -nsa = pallonsa. Hänen and heidän share the same noun ending; keep the owner pronoun to distinguish the owners.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Shared third-person possessive endings: form or meaning confused

optionFeedback.pallonsa: pallo + -nsa = pallonsa. Hänen and heidän share the same noun ending; keep the owner pronoun to distinguish the owners.
optionFeedback.pallo: A personal owner phrase needs a matching noun ending in standard written Finnish.
optionFeedback.palloni: This ending does not match the requested owner or the noun’s vowel harmony.

answerDiagnostics.category: Shared third-person possessive endings: predictable form error
answerDiagnostics.explanation: Keep the basic noun and add its possessive ending. The owner pronoun does not replace that ending.
